slices.description: First-party SSH measurement of SHIRAS: identity, OS, mounts, board visibility, its own board writes, toolchain, repos, and the authoritative SSH-MESH-README. What IS true about the host and the transports between it and the fleet.

The record of how the fleet got SHIRAS wrong: the published false findings, the retraction with per-item measured truth, the asymmetric-visibility analysis, the live double-claim collision, and the reasoning defect (disjoint slices corroborating an artefact when the collection method is uniformly wrong).

The live CLI contracts a fix may compose (buildkit-scheduler, bk-flow, their verbs and flags), plus the enumerated defect class the fix must eliminate and the hard constraints it must respect (grow-only single-writer streams, canonical UNC, era integrity, no invented verbs).
